subject: Temporary carveout request for p95 during nightly batch inference
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@fintechx.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary p95 carveout for nightly batch inference spikes

Hi Rachel,

We're seeing regular p95 latency spikes in our hosted API endpoints overnight when our nightly batch enrichment jobs run and backfill embeddings. The p95 jumps from ~120ms to ~1.6s between 02:00-03:30 UTC. This is causing downstream ETL timeouts and delayed batch jobs.

Can Redwood offer a temporary SLO adjustment or measurement carveout for those scheduled windows while we implement prefetching and KV caching? We're aiming for a 3-week window (target start Aug 21) to stabilize. I've attached a CSV with minute-level latency samples for the last 14 days (latency-metrics.csv).

Questions we have:  
- Can scheduled maintenance/spike windows be excluded from p95 calculation, or can you apply a regional transient carveout for a fixed daily window?
- What guardrails/rollback criteria would Redwood require?
- Any precedent for billing accommodation during a carveout (credits, reductions)?

Appreciate quick feedback — our ops window is pretty tight and we'd like to lock the plan before our next deploy.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Senior Platform Engineer
FintechX

Attachment: latency-metrics.csv (CSV, 482KB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@fintechx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary p95 carveout for nightly batch inference spikes

Hi Alice — thanks for the detail and the CSV, that helped.  

High-level proposal from our side:
- Scope: temporary carveout limited to the specific endpoints you listed and the regional cluster serving FintechX (us-east-1).
- Duration: proposed Aug 21 -> Sep 11 (3 weeks).
- Measurement: keep p50 unchanged; for p95 we can apply a timed carveout that excludes buckets between 02:00-03:30 UTC (the scheduled backfill window) from the daily p95 aggregation.
- Guardrails: carveout only applies if the traffic pattern matches the attached sample (we'll verify first week traffic). Automatic removal if error rates increase >0.5% above baseline for 2 consecutive days or if median latency increases >30%.
- Mitigations: we'll enable prefix caching and request prefetching suggestions on your end to reduce tail. We'll also provision a temporary auto-scale policy to mitigate unexpected peaks.

I've attached a short draft SLO addendum (sla-draft-20270811.pdf) — internal approvals needed for credits & billing. Being explicit: this is a measurement carveout (we don't change contractual uptime guarantee), and we will document the change in the customer SLO dashboard.

Would you accept the Aug 21 start? If yes, I'll loop in Ben for the credits/pricing and Marissa for sign-off on the operational rollback criteria.

Best,
Rachel
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary p95 carveout for nightly batch inference spikes

Rachel / Marissa — quick commercial note. If we grant a measurement carveout for FintechX for three weeks, recommend offering a modest goodwill credit given they are impacted in production. Proposal: 20% bill credit on hosted inference spend for the carveout period, conditional on them executing the optimization checklist (prefetch KV, deploy backoff).

Also: legal will want the SLO addendum to be explicit that this is a measurement adjustment only, and that Highland (ops) will verify traffic patterns before enabling. Please attach a HubSpot note (HS-23457) and tag finance for one-off credit approval.

I'll stand up the finance request once Marissa + legal confirm.

—Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary p95 carveout for nightly batch inference spikes

Thanks everyone — operationally I can sign off with these conditions:
1) Explicit schedule window (02:00-03:30 UTC) is locked and must be customer-specified; any divergence requires re-evaluation.
2) SRE ownership: Connor will create a dashboard and a daily health check for the first 7 days after enabling.
3) Automatic rollback triggers: error rate >0.5% or p50 increase >30% for 48h — automatic revert to standard measurement and notification to customer.
4) Credit: approve up to 20% one-time credit pending finance approval; legal to confirm language.

Connor: please create the dashboard and add runbook steps for manual scaling to dedicated capacity if spikes persist. Rachel, Ben: if FintechX signs the DocuSign acceptance we'll queue the enablement for Aug 21 at 00:00 UTC.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Rachel / Marissa / Ben — thanks for the quick turn. We accept the proposed plan and the Aug 21 start date. We'll:
- Lock the scheduled job window to 02:00-03:30 UTC for the duration.
- Run the optimization checklist and share evidence (logs + config changes) before Aug 20.
- Accept the 20% credit proposal, pending finance confirmation.

I've asked our contracts team to sign the SLO addendum via DocuSign (link below). Once signed, please proceed with the enablement and the Connor-run dashboard checks.
